description:
U by Urbeo proudly presents U Rathborne, ideally located in a superbly convenient setting beside Ashtown Village.

Location Highlights:

- Just a 5-minute walk to Ashtown Village
- Excellent rail links providing a quick commute to Dublin City Centre
- Easy access to the M50 connecting to all major routes
- Neighbourhood retail centre adjacent to Ashtown Train Station
- SuperValu, Aldi, pharmacy & cafés on your doorstep
- Only 10 minutes to Blanchardstown Shopping Centre
- 10-minute cycle or 30-minute walk to Phoenix Park (Castleknock entrance)

***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
